info.name: UBL/CII e-Invoice Viewer
info.summary: View UBL & CII e-invoices: Peppol BIS, EN 16931, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Factur-X
info.description:
Open and read electronic invoices in **UBL** and **CII** (XML) directly in Nextcloud: **Peppol BIS Billing 3.0**, **EN 16931**, **XRechnung**, **ZUGFeRD** and **Factur-X**. Since 1 January 2025, every business in Germany must be able to receive e-invoices in a structured EN 16931 format and archive them properly. This viewer helps you open and read them.
**UBL/CII e-Invoice Viewer** turns structured invoice XML into a clear, readable overview, without extra desktop software. Open an invoice from your Files, check supplier, customer, lines, VAT and totals, and generate a payment QR code when you need one.
### Features
* 📄 **UBL and CII invoices**: opens UBL and CII (Cross Industry Invoice) XML, including invoices, credit notes, corrective invoices and self-billed invoices. * 📑 **EN 16931, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 and XRechnung**: displays invoices that follow these profiles in either syntax. The viewer shows what a document contains; it does not validate or change it. * 📦 **Factur-X / ZUGFeRD**: reads the embedded XML of hybrid PDF invoices through a separate menu action. *(💡 Administrators: this requires `pdfdetach` from the **Poppler** utilities on your server.)* * 🧾 **Clear sections**: Overview, Supplier, Customer, Lines, Adjustments (allowances and charges), VAT, Totals and Payment. * 💳 **EPC / SEPA payment QR code**: generate a payment QR code on demand when the invoice contains suitable payment details. * 📱 **Works on mobile**: responsive layout for phones and tablets.
